test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can finish a piece of work in 20 days and B can finish it in 24 days. They work together for 10 days then A leaves. In how many days will B finish the remaining work?
solution:
Given:

A can finish a piece of work in 20 days and B can finish it in 24 days.

They work together for 10 days then A leaves.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per hour) × Total
